abstract: We study coordinate-line and diagonal-line cover obstructions below $\frac{9}{5}n = 1.80n$ for algebraic curve translate families $g(y) \equiv f(x) + s \pmod p$ ($s \in S_k$, fixed degree $d = \deg(f) \ge 3$ as $p \to \infty$) on $n \times n$ grid windows $W_n(x_0, y_0)$ of fixed positive aspect ratio $\lambda = n/p = a + \theta$. We resolve the Kummer branch-separation dichotomy for $y^4 \equiv x^2 + c_0 + s \pmod p$: the branch-disjoint $C_2 \otimes C_4$ ($c_0 = (p-1)/2$, $k_{\max}=18$) versus the branch-shared $\mathcal{J}_{2,4}$ ($c_0=0$, $k_{\max}=11$). For quadratic curves $g(y) = y^2 \bmod p$, we derive the position-dependent four-point horizontal multiplicity law $W_g(\lambda, \alpha)$. Using coordinatewise concavity of the finite-block minimum cover cost, we prove that $\alpha_{\min}(\theta) = \max(0, 2\theta - 1)$ is the worst-case origin over all $(x_0, y_0) \in \mathbb{Z}^2$. Evaluating all explicit monodromy laws and the degree-$16$ tail envelope certifies exclusions below $1.80n$ for quartic superelliptic curves $C_4$ ($p \equiv 1 \pmod 4$) up to $k = 16$ ($\le 1.785172$). For diagonally sheared families $(a_1 x + b_1 y)^m \equiv f(x) + s \pmod p$, we establish the reachability criterion $d \ge 2m - 1$ for $2 C_m$ and certify $k_{\max}^{\mathrm{diag}}(C_m) \in \{3, 6, 8\}$ for $m \in \{2, 3, 4\}$. The unrestricted No-Three-In-Line problem on $[0, n-1]^2$ remains open.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: 1. Resolved Critique 1: Explicitly refined the branch-disjoint (C_2 x C_4) vs branch-shared (J_2,4) Kummer dichotomy in Theorem 2, including proof of exact drifts and horizons. 2. Resolved Critique 2: Corrected Theorem 3(iii) to state the reachability criterion d >= 2m-1 for S_bivar = I_k, including referee counterexamples (S_3, 2C_3, k=3) and (S_3, 2C_4, k=3). 3. Fixed all citations to [2, Lemma 3.1; 5, Section 7.1] and ensured displayed upper bounds are rounded upward.
title: Position-Sensitive Antipodal Window Laws, Sub-Period to Superelliptic Isomorphisms, and Diagonally Sheared Curve Translate Automata Below 1.8n
